god.text:
Team, we have a schema mismatch and missing column error when blocking a customer on `/admin/customers`:

Console Errors:
1. "Could not find the function public.toggle_customer_block in the schema cache"
2. "Could not find the 'is_blocked' column of 'profiles' in the schema cache"

Please execute the following fixes immediately:

---

### Step 1: Add Missing Columns to `profiles` (Supabase Migration / SQL)
Run this SQL migration in the Supabase database:
```sql
-- 1. Add block status and reason columns to profiles if they do not exist
ALTER TABLE public.profiles 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_blocked BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS blocked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS block_reason TEXT;

-- 2. Create the toggle_customer_block RPC function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.toggle_customer_block(
  target_user_id UUID,
  should_block BOOLEAN,
  reason TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Update profiles table
  UPDATE public.profiles
  SET 
    is_blocked = should_block,
    blocked_at = CASE WHEN should_block THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
    block_reason = CASE WHEN should_block THEN reason ELSE NULL END,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = target_user_id;

  -- Optional: Update Supabase auth app_metadata to prevent login token refresh
  UPDATE auth.users
  SET raw_app_meta_data = 
    COALESCE(raw_app_meta_data, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('is_blocked', should_block)
  WHERE id = target_user_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true, 
    'user_id', target_user_id, 
    'is_blocked', should_block
  );
END;
$$;

-- Grant execution permission to authenticated service/admin roles
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.toggle_customer_block TO authenticated, service_role;
